title: Engine and mechanical revision identification
detail: IH small-journal crank dimensions differ from later DT466E sheet. SRC lists narrow bearings and an NG head/piston; a measured journal alone does not establish all specification compatibility.
required_evidence: Record serial, block/head/crank/cam casting and part numbers, journal diameter AND width, bearing marks, rod/bolt types; obtain applicable OEM build/parts and service specification confirmation.

title: Head procedure source hierarchy — resolved
detail: Resolved by project instruction: use SRC final head torque 170 ft-lb; use original IH procedure for details absent from SRC. Use IH intermediate stages 110 and 155 ft-lb with sequence A, then SRC 170 ft-lb with IH sequence B. Bolt lubrication, washer identification, .005-in rocker bracket gauge, first-stage rocker freedom check and first-hour retorque/lash follow-up use IH 1-59,1-81–82. This is a traceable combination of sources under the project rule; no single manual prints the combined 110/155/170 schedule.
required_evidence: No additional SRC document is required solely because SRC omits the procedure. Confirm fitted head/bolt/gasket identity under V01/V03; retain actual torque records. The unchanged measurement sec-6 still has 165 ft-lb, so cross-reference the actual 170 record rather than falsely attesting its old checkbox.

title: Natural gas piston, rings, pin and head limits
detail: SRC N104108 is an NG 8.5:1 piston; N104011 is an NG head. Diesel ring profiles, gaps, groove limits, piston protrusion, pin fit and valve machining values are not automatically approved for these parts.
required_evidence: SRC or component manufacturer drawing/service sheet for fitted piston/ring/liner/head/valves, including gaps, fits, recession, head thickness/resurfacing allowance and ring orientation.

title: Valve lash temperature and cover torque
detail: SRC states .025 in but does not explicitly state hot/cold in the cited adjustment procedure. Existing checklist labels it warm. SRC p17 says 36 in-lb; p33 says sheet metal 26 in-lb, aluminum 40 ±10 in-lb.
required_evidence: Confirm lash temperature condition and installed cover/grommet tightening specification. Do not silently assume warm or select one cover value.

title: TA ignition timing and controls commissioning
detail: TA town gas is 27° BTDC; pipeline, wellhead and landfill entries are TBD. NA values are separate and are not transferable. Diesel injection timing does not set spark timing.
required_evidence: Applicable SRC ignition system installation/indexing, cylinder/lead routing, timing curve and setting method for serial, fuel analysis and controller; shutdown/overspeed verification procedure.

title: Fuel specification and pressure disagreement
source: SRC 7; generator data sheet fuel table
detail: SRC says at least 70% methane or 950–1100 BTU/ft³; data sheet says methane 90% minimum and lower heating value 890 BTU/ft³ minimum. Data sheet mixer pressure 3.5–5.5 in H2O is application specific.
required_evidence: Confirm fuel composition, pressure measurement point, loaded/unloaded limits, regulator/lockoff/mixer setup and approved gas leak test with SRC for this build.

title: Run-in, cam bedding and load rating
detail: SRC first 100 h: half to three-quarter load, no maximum load >5 min; refers to 100 kW. Data sheet has 125 kW prime. IH cam recommendation 1000 rpm for 3–5 min may conflict with constant-speed genset controls. Existing load-bank schedule is not an OEM-approved substitute.
required_evidence: Written rebuilt-engine/cam run-in plan, applicable electrical and engine rating, load steps/durations, temperature/oil pressure limits and head retorque integration; approve test equipment and follow-up log.

title: Pressure tests: source unit discrepancies
detail: IH oil cooler text pairs 935 kPa with 150 psi; these are not equivalent. Do not choose either silently. System pressure and induction test limits depend on installed assembly.
required_evidence: Confirm test pressure, medium, temperature, restraint, duration and acceptance criteria for cooler, head, cooling and intake assemblies; calibrated protected test rig.

title: Damper and seal assembly variants
detail: SRC pulley value 105 ft-lb agrees with IH rubber damper; IH viscous hub is 125 and damper screws 35 ft-lb. Seal kits may have different lubrication/installation instructions from the old IH lip seal. Historical asbestos glove instruction must not be followed. SRC 105 ft-lb governs over the original checklist sec-6 pulley 125 entry; verify hardware/method applicability, not a different default torque.
required_evidence: Identify damper and seal kit; obtain installed-part instructions, seal depth/tool/adhesive/lubrication and torque applicability. Use modern rated heat PPE.

title: Accessory hardware and missing procedures
detail: SRC turbo mounting unit is printed 35 LB/LBS; OPR wording is resolved by IH 1-198 identifying the threaded regulator. Fan, flywheel coupling, starter, alternator, ignition and fuel hardware lack complete applicable instructions here. SRC oil-pan 20 ft-lb takes precedence over IH 15 ft-lb; that numerical difference is resolved. The original checklist sec-6 lists drain plug 33 ft-lb; SRC p33 27 ft-lb governs instead.
required_evidence: Applicable accessory/coupling manuals and fastener identification; clarify turbo torque unit; obtain remaining fastener, sealant, pre-lube pressure and electrical/normal oil-pressure test specifications. Oil-pan final torque is SRC 20 ft-lb.

title: Block, liner and bearing family release
detail: IH prohibits block deck resurfacing (1-172) and sleeve honing (1-146). Main housing bore limits and liner seal arrangement must match installed block. OEM general fit procedures do not authorize arbitrary machining.
required_evidence: Applicable block/liner/bearing dimensions and seals, supported cap/line-bore repair plan if needed, machine-shop measurements and final disposition. Document main/rod clearances for actual crank family.
